layers.role: classify retrieval requirement and allocate retrieval/traversal/context budget
transient query/frame-conditioned scores and relation paths
bounded model-visible packet/assertion/source set with exact-anchor fallback

assembly_plan_contract.rule: The planner chooses retrieval behavior but never evidence status or effect authority.

SEMANTIC_ASSOCIATIVE.must_use_exact_anchor: when answer depends on current/exact truth

seed_fusion.rule: Graph selection must be benchmarked against the runtime deterministic packet envelope; the envelope remains fallback until superiority is demonstrated.

expansion_gate.target_relevance_rule: Expansion through a qualified edge still requires independent query relevance or an explicitly requested multihop bridge role.
expansion_gate.stop_rule: Stop when budget is exhausted or marginal qualified evidence gain falls below the configured threshold; fixed K/hops is baseline not doctrine.

status_policy.current_queries: suppress STALE/REFUTED unless necessary to explain a contradiction

evidence_family_policy.rule: Shared ancestry reduces independent-evidence weight and duplicate context; do not hard-delete all but one descendant because distinct experiment/negative/architecture roles can be useful.

frank_mapping.S.COGNITIVE_FRAME: may scope current assembly but remains exact causal truth outside graph
frank_mapping.M.WORKSPACE_ARBITER: receives memory candidates; graph activation is not workspace ignition

hard_invariants: current/exact claims can be revalidated at exact anchor
graph activation does not multiply evidence strength
model/graph output does not mint authority
secrets/bearer capabilities excluded from graph/model context

evidence_boundary.cycle2_proxy: mixed positive: better stale suppression/family coverage and erroneous-edge robustness; no held-out recall gain and slightly lower held-out precision
evidence_boundary.external_convergence: adaptive traversal, plan-guided fusion, projection-aware source grounding and bounded retrieval are supported as implementation/research patterns, not ClayGraph-specific proof
